SELECT b.id AS id, b.tier AS tier FROM notebook_bases e JOIN notebooks b ON b.id = e.base_notebook_id JOIN notebooks a ON a.id = e.notebook_id CROSS JOIN (SELECT NULLIF('', '') AS uid) v WHERE e.notebook_id = 'nb-00000000000000000000000000000001' AND b.id != e.notebook_id AND ((b.status NOT IN ('copying','deleting','importing') AND (b.tier = 'base' OR b.created_by = a.created_by OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notebook_grants nge WHERE nge.notebook_id=b.id AND nge.principal_type='everyone') OR ((EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notebook_members nm WHERE nm.notebook_id=b.id AND nm.user_id=a.created_by) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notebook_grants ng WHERE ng.notebook_id=b.id AND ((ng.principal_type='user' AND ng.principal_id=a.created_by) OR (ng.principal_type='group' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members ngm WHERE ngm.group_id=ng.principal_id AND ngm.user_id=a.created_by)) OR (ng.principal_type='group_admins' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members nga WHERE nga.group_id=ng.principal_id AND nga.user_id=a.created_by AND nga.role='admin'))))) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notebook_members xm WHERE xm.notebook_id = a.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notebook_grants xg WHERE xg.notebook_id = a.id))))) AND (b.tier = 'base' OR (b.created_by=v.uid OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notebook_members vm WHERE vm.notebook_id=b.id AND vm.user_id=v.uid) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notebook_grants vg WHERE vg.notebook_id=b.id AND ((vg.principal_type='user' AND vg.principal_id=v.uid) OR (vg.principal_type='group' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members vgm WHERE vgm.group_id=vg.principal_id AND vgm.user_id=v.uid)) OR (vg.principal_type='group_admins' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members vga WHERE vga.group_id=vg.principal_id AND vga.user_id=v.uid AND vga.role='admin')) OR vg.principal_type='everyone'))))) ORDER BY CASE WHEN b.tier = 'base' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, b.name, b.id
